figurative_meaning_en: A rented house for temporary residence
example_sentences_in_bangla: কলকাতায় চাকরির জন্য একটা বাসাবাড়ি নিয়েছি।
example_sentences_in_english: I've taken a rented place in Kolkata for my job.
I used to stay in temporary lodging in the city during my studies.
note: Commonly used in contexts of urban relocation in Bengal, especially Kolkata.
